  • Constructor Details

    • Book

      public Book(long ID, String title, String author, String series, int pages, String note)
      Constructor used when creating a NEW book (will append to CSV) This is used when a user wants a new book created. Also writes to the CSV using toCSV(). This is very similar to the other constructor, but since this one is under the condition its a brand new book, some variables are just set to their defaults.
      Parameters:
      ID - a unique value assigned to the book. The Runner.findNextID() method ensures there's no gaps for neatness
      title - the title of the book.
      author - the author of the book.
      series - the series of the book, if no value is given it defaults to "None" as specified in Runner.BookNew()
      pages - the amount of pages of the book.
      note - A note. This one defaults to "None" as well,
      See Also:
      • Book(long, String, String, String, int, int, String, String, String)

    • Book

      public Book(long ID, String title, String author, String series, int pages, int pagesDone, String dateCreated, String dateFinished, String note)
      Constructor used when loading from CSV (DO NOT write back to file) This Constructor is used when initially loading data from the CSV. Its used to define every variable of the Book objects.
      Parameters:
      ID - a unique value assigned to the book. The Runner.findNextID() method ensures there's no gaps for neatness
      title - the title of the book.
      author - the author of the book.
      series - the series of the book, if no value is given it defaults to "None" as specified in Runner.BookNew()
      pages - the amount of pages of the book.
      pagesDone - the amount of pages done in the book.
      dateCreated - the date the book was created. Is defined only when using the "for user" constructor. It is defined using LocalDate.now().
      dateFinished - the date the book was finished, is default (and usually) set to "None". Is set to a real date by setPagesDone(int)
      note - A note. This one defaults to "None" as well.
      See Also:
      • Book(long, String, String, String, int, String)
      • Runner.BookNew()
      • setPagesDone(int)

    • toCSV

      private void toCSV()
      appends to CSV This method appends a new Book object to the end of the file using Files.write().
      See Also:
      • writeCSV()

    • writeCSV

      private void writeCSV()
      Update pagesDone in-memory AND persist the change by replacing the matching CSV line. Matching is done by title, author and pages (trimmed comparison). While toCSV() just appends to the end, this changes a line in the middle using the ID system.
      See Also:

    • viewForm

      public String viewForm()
      The main method for viewing books. Is used in Runner.BookList() An example output, where all variables equal their default values: 
      Title: ""
Author: ""
Series: ""
Pages: 0
Pages done: 0
Percent done 0%
_______________
Date created: 0/0/0000
Date finished: 0/0/0000
Note: ""
